questions.q: Laylatul Qadr is better than how many months?
questions.explain: Surah Al-Qadr says that night is better than a thousand months.

questions.q: Worship on Laylatul Qadr equals more than how many years?
questions.explain: A thousand months is more than 83 years.

questions.q: Who is Ar-Ruh who descends with the angels that night?
questions.explain: Ar-Ruh is Jibril AS, who descends with the angels.

questions.q: Who threatened to stamp on the Prophet's SAW neck while he was prostrating?
questions.explain: Abu Jahal threatened but backed away in fear.

questions.q: Why did Abu Jahal back away?
options: Because he saw fire and wings coming to protect him
questions.explain: Jibril came to protect the Prophet SAW until Abu Jahal backed off.

questions.q: What does Allah condemn in people like Abu Jahal?
questions.explain: Allah condemns those who stop His servant from praying. We must not prevent people from worshipping.

questions.q: The angels and Ar-Ruh descend on Laylatul Qadr by their Lord's permission.
questions.explain: True. Surah Al-Qadr says the angels and Ar-Ruh descend that night.

questions.q: The world is a place to stay forever.
questions.explain: False. The world is only a temporary stop for tests before we return to Allah.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: The Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful
Generous, who loves to give much
The night better than a thousand months

questions.explain: Laylatul Qadr is the night better than a thousand months, karim means generous, Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim means Most Compassionate and Merciful, and sentosa means peaceful.

questions.q: When someone feels they have enough wealth and power, what danger may follow?
options: They easily wrong others and overstep limits
questions.explain: People who feel they have enough wealth and power easily wrong others.
